runtime.profile: headless, created from the shipped template in a fresh isolated DSH_HOME

registry_check.command: npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh versions --json and npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags --json

accept.method: dsh plugin --profile headless add <checked-out package> in a fresh isolated profile
accept.details: Exit 0. The profile added the dependency and the plugin bundle. --dump-config listed the enabled claude-code-session entry and printed no skipping message. The issue #1 post-push GitHub spec install on the same dsh version also installed the plugin.

reject_at_install.method: git archive of origin/main under /tmp with engines.dsh changed to 0.2.3; dsh plugin --profile headless add /tmp/engines-mismatch
reject_at_install.details: Exit 1. The message named the plugin, the running dsh version, the requirement, the risk, and the exemption command, and ended with 'dsh: nothing was installed.' The host also printed the exact remedy command. The profile package.json dependencies stayed empty and the plugin was not installed. The repository was not changed.
reject_at_install.rejection_prefix: dsh: installation rejected: Plugin dsh-plugin-claude-code@0.2.0 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-rc.1: requirements {"engines.dsh":"0.2.3"}.

reject_at_startup.method: Installed copy from the GitHub spec in an isolated profile. engines.dsh changed to 0.2.3 in the installed package.json. dsh --profile headless --dump-config.
reject_at_startup.details: Exit 0. The boot printed 'dsh: skipping profile bundle "dsh-plugin-claude-code": Error: Plugin dsh-plugin-claude-code@0.2.0 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.2-rc.1: requirements {"engines.dsh":"0.2.3"}.' The claude-code-session entry was absent from the composed tree. After the manifest restore, the entry returned and the message was absent.

offline_suite: pass at the time of the measurement
proven: The npm registry has no dsh release later than 0.2.2-rc.1.
The tested dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 accepts the exact engines.dsh requirement and activates the plugin bundle.
An untested engine requirement is rejected at install with a clear message and no installation.
An installed plugin with an untested engine requirement is skipped at startup with a clear message, and unrelated plugins still boot.
not_proven: A real later dsh release; none exists.
The exact-version exemption flow; the host printed the command but it was not run.
Plugin behavior on any dsh version other than 0.2.2-rc.1.
